subject: NexusHealth: request to retire assistant artifacts (prompts/outputs/logs)
messages:
From: Jane Foster <jane.foster@nexushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: dataops@nexushealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to retire assistant artifacts (prompts/outputs/logs)

Hi Marcus,

We need Redwood to remove all assistant-related artifacts generated for NexusHealth customer workspace 'nexus-prod' for the period between 2027-05-01 and 2027-12-31. This includes:
- user prompts and model outputs stored in prompt-output logs,
- per-request runtime logs that contain prompt identifiers,
- any KV-cache snapshots linked to the workspace.

Our legal/privacy team requires a confirmation email with:
1) the workflow you used to identify and remove artifacts,
2) a short attestation that artifacts were removed (or the remediation plan if anything cannot be removed), and
3) the names of artifacts/results (report stub) and a delivery link.

Attached is our high-level removal scope (nexus_removal_scope_20280110.pdf). Can you confirm estimated timeline and next steps? NexusHealth needs the attestation by EOD Friday 2028-01-13 to satisfy an audit.

Thanks,
Jane Foster
Data Privacy Lead
NexusHealth

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Foster <jane.foster@nexushealth.com>
Cc: dataops@nexushealth.com, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to retire assistant artifacts (prompts/outputs/logs)

Hi Jane — thanks for the scope doc and the clear deadline. High-level plan below; I want to confirm the approach before executing.

Summary of proposed workflow:
1) Identification: run the NexusHealth workspace tag query + timeline filter to enumerate all prompt/output records and runtime logs that reference the workspace id.
2) Pre-check: snapshot identifiers and generate a non-sensitive manifest (artifact ids only) for your review.
3) Removal: schedule a staged deletion:
   - Stage A (non-blocking): remove prompt-output derivatives and cached KV snapshots (these are safe to remove immediately),
   - Stage B (log sweep): remove runtime logs that contain full prompt text; we will redact and then remove if legal requires full erasure,
   - Stage C (final audit): produce the sweep report (PDF) and the KV manifest CSV for chain-of-custody.
4) Verification: internal ops sign-off + external attestation email sent to NexusHealth with the report and a link to the redacted evidence.

Estimated timeline: identification and pre-check by 2028-01-11 EOD; removal and report generation by 2028-01-12 EOD.

Questions for NexusHealth:
- Confirm that the timeframe 2027-05-01 through 2027-12-31 is correct.
- Confirm whether redaction (replace prompt content with hashed token) is acceptable for runtime logs, or whether full deletion is required.

If that all looks good I will kick off the identification job and share the manifest for review.

Marcus
Sr. Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Jane Foster <jane.foster@nexushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: dataops@nexushealth.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to retire assistant artifacts (prompts/outputs/logs)

Hi Marcus — thanks. Confirming: timeframe correct. NexusHealth requires full deletion of the prompt text and model outputs (no redaction). Runtime logs may be redacted if the redacted copy still retains necessary telemetry for production debugging; otherwise delete. Please proceed with Stage A+B. We will review the manifest once you share it.

Jane

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jan 2028 16:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request to retire assistant artifacts (prompts/outputs/logs) — completion & attestation

Hi Jane and Marcus,

This is a confirmation that Redwood completed the scoped artifact retirement for NexusHealth (workspace: nexus-prod) covering 2027-05-01 through 2027-12-31. Work performed: identification, staged removal, and audit report generation.

What we removed:
- Prompt-output records (derivative store): 18,742 artifact ids removed.
- KV-cache snapshots: 23 snapshots removed.
- Runtime log entries containing prompt text: redaction attempted per policy; NexusHealth requested full deletion and we deleted 4,230 log entries that contained unredacted prompt text.

Artifacts delivered:
- sweep_report_20280112.pdf (summary + verification timestamps + ops sign-off) [attachment]
- kv_cache_manifest_20280112.csv (artifact ids and deletion timestamps) [attachment]

Notes and exceptions:
- We did not remove aggregated analytics records (token counts, latency metrics) since they are non-identifying and excluded by our retention policy. If you require those removed, let us know and we will queue a separate analytics scrub which typically takes 3–5 business days.
- Chain-of-custody: SEC-4492 ticket updated with deletion job IDs and storage location pointers.

Attestation (signed by Redwood Ops):
"Redwood Inference attests that the listed artifacts were removed from our production stores and underlying caches on 2028-01-12. Deletion jobs completed successfully and were validated by internal verification scripts."
If this satisfies NexusHealth's audit please reply with a confirmation and we will close the ticket. Otherwise list any residual items and we'll escalate immediately.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Trust & Safety — Redwood Inference
